finding: The binding constraint is object-level relational structure that is not recoverable from pixel context — not compute.
span: Two years, roughly twelve solver architectures.
note: Seeded from the repositories that still carry a description. The failure column is the substance of this page and is filled in per architecture as each is written up.

architectures.name: OpinionAI
architectures.approach: 19M-parameter encoder over pixel-level embeddings with zero information loss, selecting from 64 primitive operations, flash cross-attention between demonstrations and test input, and coupled shape/content heads trained on a dense ordinal plus geometric-coupling loss.

architectures.name: Opinion
architectures.approach: ARC Prize 2025 entry. Successor to OpinionAI, retaining the pixel-embedding and primitive-selection pipeline under PyTorch Lightning.

architectures.name: TyleDSL
architectures.approach: A typed reformulation of Michael Hodel's ARC-DSL, using the type system to prune the search space of candidate programs.
